schemes.oauth2.description: "OAuth 2.0 access token. For the client credentials flow, set `audience` to the API base URL without the `/public/v2` path (for example `https://public-api.drata.com`). Use the authorization server for your region: `https://drata-prod.us.auth0.com` (US), `https://drata-prod.eu.auth0.com` (EU), or `https://drata-prod.au.auth0.com` (APAC)."
